recommended_reasoning.reason: The mechanical move is simple; the judgement is in resolving two frozen contracts that disagree without silently reconciling them, and in not losing a byte of backlog history while doing it.

requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law
The amendment is written as a proposal. Do not mark it approved, and do not change GOV.ORCH.5's own status line.
If the 60 KB target still cannot be reached after every open-item note is moved, report the exact remaining size and what else holds the bytes. Do not delete content to hit a number.
Report the before and after byte size of project/backlog.json in SESSION_CLOSE, measured, not estimated.
Do not weaken, skip or delete an existing test. The budget test's ceiling may only move downward.
AGENTS.md forbids silently reconciling two frozen contracts that disagree. Report the disagreement in the amendment text and in SESSION_CLOSE.
Do not open a pull request and do not merge. Commit on the lane and publish SESSION_CLOSE.
risks: Deleting note text instead of moving it, to reach the number faster.
Hand-editing project/backlog.json and breaking GOV.ORCH.5's single-write-path rule.
Raising the ceiling instead of shrinking the file, which the Product Owner has explicitly refused.
Marking the GOV.ORCH.5 amendment as approved, repeating the agent-authority problem already recorded against this repository.
Curating the backlog while moving it, so a status or priority silently changes.
